name: turkiye-iban-repo
description: Official-source-first Turkish IBAN provider data and packages.

scripts.lint: python -m compileall -q scripts tools examples && npm -w packages/typescript run typecheck
scripts.test:examples: npm run build && node examples/javascript.mjs && python examples/data_files.py
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:generated && npm run validate:data && npm run check:privacy && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:examples && npm run test:release
